admission.justification: The ready message-switch is the rail family guarantee selection leg; typed per-case proofs were withdrawn as extractor-unsupported.

applicability: Selection changes between master, tasks and roles while the control channel is ready, inside and across workspaces.
conditions: The ready channel supports opening the target agent; agent/workspace identity remains canonical.
A load readiness wait holds the latest selection until ready/pong before switching by message.
exclusions: An explicitly unsupported-open plugin uses URL steering with its notice.
Only application ping silence, Retry or host return permits recovery loading; deadline lateness alone does not.
Known-no-agent selections hide; unknown discovery retains the visible inert frame.

evidence: sidebarChatStaysLoaded.test.tsx (ar.open with workspaceId, element and generation unchanged) + e2e/document-chat-cross-workspace.spec.ts (L121 retained)

statement: With an open-capable ready channel, selected-document changes switch the same application by ar.open inside/across workspaces without reload; during a load ready wait latest selection is held then messaged. A timeout alone does not make the channel unavailable; unanswered ping permits fallback. An explicitly unsupported-open plugin steers each target by URL; known agentless selections hide, unknown selections remain visible and held.
